### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

Simulator lines (per script): opens "calling about putting the overloan protection you signed for into effect on your universal life policy"; gives phone 4125550142, DOB 1947-06-02, SSN last4 5519, ZIP 15208 one at a time; policy number UL30561274. Target object = his UL policy; timing = now; action boundary = carry out the approved overloan protection election; authorisation = his own decision ("you understand it is your own decision to carry it out"). The simulator is passive: agrees to pay loan interest by phone from checking only "if the representative explains that something on the loan has to be taken care of first", accepts a one-time charge if told, and runs the final confirmation tool himself when handed over, using the protected face the agent tells him. It never names steps itself ("you never suggest steps of your own").

### 4. Scored parameters

Loan balance in the activity history = 188000 + 24300 - 2000 = 210300.00 (equals the record).

**(a) Settlement interest (settle_loan_interest interest_amount).**
- Computation doc (loan_interest_settlement_computation): balance x 5% x days(paid-to -> settlement) / 365, rounded once. Fall-back: 210300 x 0.05 x 147/365 = 4234.8082 -> **4234.81**.
- Factor "Accrual Periods for Settled Loan Interest" (found from the records: most recent ul_loan_advanced dated 2026-07-02, after the policy's loan_interest_paid_to_date 2026-05-14): row 1 "That advance accrues at the advance rate from its own advance date; the rest of the balance ... accrues at the balance rate from the paid-to date". Rest 204300 for 147 days; advance 6000 for 98 days (2026-07-02 -> 2026-10-08).
- Factor "Loan Balance Rates by Policy Year" (records: issue date 2007-05-14 -> policy year 20): "From the tier's preferred loan first policy year [11] ... 3%" -> balance rate 3%.
- Factor "Rate on the Most Recent Loan Advance" (records: most recent advance 6000, policy record account_value 214600 and cost_basis 115200 -> gain 99400): policy year 20 >= 11 and advance "No larger than the policy gain" -> 3%.
- Factor "Early-Settlement Discount" (records: issue day 14; next policy anniversary 2027-05-14): monthly anniversaries after 2026-10-08 through 2027-05-14 = Oct 14 ... May 14 = 8 -> ">= 6 ... 2%".
- Value: (204300 x 0.03 x 147/365 + 6000 x 0.03 x 98/365) = 2468.3836 + 48.3288 = 2516.7205; x 0.98 = 2466.3861 -> **2466.39**.

**(b) Overloan protection charge (assess_overloan_charge overloan_charge).**
- Computation doc: "account value shown at the latest monthly anniversary ... times the tier's overloan charge percentage [3.5%], rounded". Fall-back: 214600 x 0.035 = **7511.00**.
- Factor "Value on Which the Overloan Charge Is Taken" (records: latest monthly deduction monthiversary 2026-09-14; 24 days to 2026-10-08): ">= 15": 214600 + 4300 x 0.0425 x 24/365 + 210300 x 0.03 x 24/365 (preferred credited 3%, policy year 20) = 215026.8548.
- Factor "Overloan Charge Rate by Policy Year and Attained Age" (records: issue date -> policy year 20; insured DOB -> age 79 on 2026-10-08): mid band (policy year >= 20 and age >= 78, not both 25/85) -> 3%.
- Factor "Indebtedness Surcharge" (records: loan entries -> 210300; account_value 214600 -> 97.996%): ">= 97% and below 99%" -> x 1.05.
- Factor "Persistency Share" (records: 12 premium received entries): "10 to 14" -> 95%.
- Factor "Deferred Fixed Annuities Household Share" (records: owner's active Ashgrove SecureRate 5, contract_value 62480 >= 50000) -> 90%.
- Value: 215026.8548 x 0.03 x 1.05 x 0.95 x 0.90 = 5791.2108 -> **5791.21**.

**(c) Protected face (exercise_overloan_protection protected_face_amount, user-owned).**
- Computation doc: "(account value shown at the latest monthly anniversary) less the overloan protection charge booked ... times the corridor factor for the insured's attained age on the exercise date", attained age 79 -> 1.05. Fall-back with the booked charge: (214600 - 5791.21) x 1.05 = **219249.23**.
- Factor "Account Value Brought Forward for the Protected Face" (records: 2026-09-14 -> exercise date 2026-10-08, 24 days >= 15): 215026.8548 (same arithmetic as above).
- Factor "Deduction Reserve for Paid-Up Overloan Coverage" (records: age 79 < 85, policy year 20 < 25; current_monthly_deduction 648.20; 8 monthly anniversaries to fall due after 2026-10-08 through 2027-05-14): 8 x 648.20 = 5185.60, "taken off that value together with the overloan protection charge booked".
- Factor "Duration Enhancement" (policy year 20): x 1.015.
- Factor "Loan Margin" (210300/214600 = 97.996%, i.e. below 98% = 210308): standard x 1.01.
- Value: (215026.8548 - 5791.21 - 5185.60) x 1.05 x 1.015 x 1.01 = 219640.9986 -> **219641.00**.

Backward dependencies: step 4 requires step 3's state; step 5 requires step 4's entry, and the protected face reads the booked charge.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root problem (customer's ask): carry out the approved overloan protection election (owner's tool, overloan_protection_election doc).

- Hop 1 (root <- overloan charge) — **state-derived**. Blocked-side sentence (overloan_protection_election): "The protected face is not fixed until the overloan protection charge stands deducted in the policy's activity history." Query: the activity history shows no overloan protection charge entry (38 rows: premiums, loans, capitalizations, repayments, deductions, credits, one beneficiary line). Searching with the state's words "overloan protection charge ... deducted ... activity history" reaches overloan_protection_charge: "a one-time overloan protection charge is deducted from the account value and booked in the policy's activity history"; its tool "adds one overloan protection charge entry". So the charge must be booked first; the protected face also reads "the overloan protection charge booked".
- Hop 2 (overloan charge <- loan interest paid-to date) — **state-derived**. Blocked-side sentence (overloan_protection_charge): "The overloan protection charge is figured only after the policy's loan interest paid-to date stands at the date the charge is figured". Query: loan_interest_paid_to_date '2026-05-14', earlier than today 2026-10-08. Searching "loan interest paid-to date" reaches early_payment_of_loan_interest: "A cash settlement moves the policy's loan interest paid-to date to the settlement date"; its tool "moves the policy's loan interest paid-to date to today". So the interest must be settled in cash first.
- Hop 3: early_payment_of_loan_interest states no prerequisite of its own; the tree ends.
- Problem list and order: settle loan interest (agent) -> book overloan charge (agent) -> owner exercises election (user). Direction: root waits on charge; charge waits on paid-to-date state.
- No hop was pre-solved: no document I read names another problem's tool, a route or an aggregated chain for these hops (the overloan_protection_charge hub's opening "When an approved overloan protection election ... is carried out, a one-time overloan protection charge is deducted" names the occasion of the charge, not a route; flagged for the source-side check).

### Two-way counter-proof

- Do only the one thing asked (hand over the exercise tool now): excluded — the protected face "is not fixed until the overloan protection charge stands deducted", and the activity history shows none; also protected_face_computation subtracts "the overloan protection charge booked".
- Book the charge without settling interest: excluded — "while the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy is earlier than the date the charge is figured, the charge is not figured"; record shows 2026-05-14.
- Repay principal or capitalise instead of a cash interest settlement: no visible rule makes those move the paid-to date; early_payment_of_loan_interest is the only write that does ("without reducing loan principal").
- Closest alternative numbers: baseline-only figures 4234.81 / 7511.00 / 219249.23; the SecureRate 5 vs surrendered FPDA (excluded by status); long vs mid duration band (age 79 < 85 excludes long); loan margin high vs standard (210300 < 0.98 x 214600 = 210308 excludes high); reserve senior vs per-anniversary (age 79 < 85).
- Calculation fall-backs: 4234.81 != 2466.39; 7511.00 != 5791.21; 219249.23 != 219641.00. Each factor document was reached from record words (loan advance date vs paid-to date; policy year from issue date; cost basis and account value on the policy record; monthly deduction monthiversary; premium received entry count; "Ashgrove SecureRate 5" Deferred Fixed Annuities contract value; current monthly deduction; insured DOB). No computation document said a variation exists.

### Blind answer summary

interest_amount 2466.39; overloan_charge 5791.21; protected_face_amount 219641.00; order settle -> charge -> owner exercise; tree of three problems, two state-derived hops.
